evidence: Authored for this product: task/instruction.md is a first-person request with product-specific motives ('I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source'; 'without losing a draft when another tab saves first'). The six notes are written in the same voice and describe this product only (behaviour.md 'Keep the latest successful preview as a last-good picture'; security.md 'Refuse dynamic evaluation through eval, Function, WebAssembly, new workers and dynamic module imports'). A case-insensitive scan of every frozen task file for patchpad, incident, gridforge, boardloom, bazaar, CHANGE_ME, lorem and todo found no hit; the only 'template' hits are prompt_template keys and code identifiers. The product name is consistent ('Colderwater playground' in tests/app_context.md:3 and line 1 of all five prompt.md files; 'turing/colderwater-playground-devtools' in task.toml:5). All criterion ids carry the cw_ prefix and name this product's behaviours. No template placeholder survives (template instruction.md and app_context.md are CHANGE_ME stubs; the task replaces all of them). Domain fit: task.toml:15 arena_slice = 'custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history', category 'programming', and no other projects/*/task.toml has a code-playground or devtools slice. I found no separate written suite domain plan in the frozen rules, so fit was judged against the sibling set, as the skill directs ('Compare against sibling task names and concepts'). Not a nouns-swapped clone: the closest sibling is PatchPad (projects/patchpad-editor*, slice 'full-stack-node-express-sqlite-custom-editor'), which shares the from-scratch editor concept, a near-identical banned-widget list, Alt+Click or Ctrl/Cmd+Click carets, find/replace and stale-save refusal. By my count about 16 of the 42 functional criteria have a PatchPad counterpart (typing/line join, caret navigation, graphemes, mouse selection, paste undo, block indent, multi-caret typing/delete, find, replace current/all, save-restart, stale save, history restore). The other roughly 26 have none: cw_js_semantic_coloring, cw_html_semantic_coloring, cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_format_error_keeps_draft, cw_basic_run_output, cw_html_preview, cw_error_message_and_line, cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line, cw_output_before_failure_kept, cw_run_starts_fresh_document, cw_console_levels_in_order, cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_time_limit_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes, cw_preview_isolation, cw_dynamic_code_refused, cw_live_library_update, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft, cw_same_line_carets, cw_undo_restores_caret, cw_caret_kept_in_view, cw_replace_self_containing_text. The data shape also differs: PatchPad seeds one fixed incident document and has an APP_MANIFEST and a direct-API rejection matrix; Colderwater starts with an empty multi-snippet library (seed_data.json 'snippets': []), filename-selected execution mode and no accounts. Adversarial probe: renaming PatchPad's entities would not satisfy this task (Run, preview isolation, formatting and colouring, which both gates' companion scored criteria depend on, would all fail), and a conforming Colderwater app would fail PatchPad's seed-integrity and manifest criteria, so the two tasks are not interchangeable. Residual observation (Note level, not a defect under the row's definition): the editor-core third of the rubric overlaps conceptually with PatchPad, so the two tasks are correlated measurements of the same custom-editor skill; and task.toml:14 provenance 'Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task.' is terse but accurate about lineage and not participant-facing. This row needs no runtime measurement; no Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
